scope: Native gallery previews for already-authorized durable local video files.
origin: Zoen integration using public AVFoundation APIs; no additional Telegram code copied for this fix.

official_references.contract: Asynchronous first-frame image generation, preferred track transform and cancellation.
Bound decoded image dimensions rather than generating the full native-resolution frame.
forbidAll permits only media stored inside the exact leased container, excluding secondary local or remote references.

lifetime: GalleryItem retains its existing cache/tmp regular-file, symlink-resolution and 64 MiB validation.
Only local video takes the new first-frame path; PHImageManager and still-image decode are unchanged.
The view starts video image requests on window attachment and cancels on window removal or retirement.
Both request owner and display view fence completion by generation; a task does not retain its display owner.
One bounded in-memory CGImage/UIImage is retained per existing surface; no new file, thumbnail cache or durable state is written.

tests.execution: Host macOS SwiftPM XCTest with byte-identical production helper and actual H.264 files created by AVAssetWriter.
behaviors: First-frame decoded pixels distinguish red first frame from blue later frames; maximum dimension is bounded.
Preferred track transform produces portrait output.
Replacing, cancelling or releasing an owner does not deliver stale results.
Malformed local media fails and a subsequent valid retry succeeds.
Nonlocal URLs and invalid dimensions are refused before decoder creation.
Source hash and fixture directory contents stay unchanged.

limits: Actual Gallery/Photos/UIKit interaction and iOS visual validation remain part of the integrated app batch.
The SDK typecheck includes actual Gallery/motion/mosaic/glass sources; only unrelated Expo host prefix and File maximumBytes declaration are extracted from production.
No bridge, permission, journal, Photos request, playback, night-theme contrast or send behavior is changed.
